**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP)**

- **Cap and mutuality are fine.** §§ 9.1 and 9.2 mirror each other at "the greater of $100,000 or the charges paid by Customer to IBM ... in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding" the first claim, with indemnity payments and bodily injury/property damage outside the cap, and § 10 excludes consequential damages mutually. That meets the fallback on cap basis and mutuality.
- **Carve-outs fail the fallback.** Only indemnification is excluded. Confidentiality is affirmatively pulled *inside* the cap by § 6 ("the provisions of Sections 5, 9, and 10 herein will prevail"), and there is no exclusion for gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. § 9.1(c)(2) also one-sidedly excludes IBM liability for loss of Customer records or data.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** inserted a new § 9.3 "Excluded Claims" applying mutually and overriding the § 6 precedence sentence — smallest edit that reaches the preferred position without reopening the cap amount.
